subject: Data Structures & Algorithms
title: Why is my recursive merge sort stack overflowing?
author: Alexa Canaria
content: I'm implementing merge sort recursively in C. It works for small arrays, but it crashes with a stack overflow once the array has around 100,000 elements. Is my base case wrong, or should I be doing this iteratively?
